environment.description: Same Celery worker on EC2 in private subnet (no IGW). The upload API sits behind an internal NLB (Network Load Balancer) with a target group health check on /health. Ingress to the NLB is controlled by a security group allowing TCP/8080 only from source prefix list pl-0a2f7d8e91b (which resolves to 10.20.0.0/16 and 172.16.4.0/22 — the corporate VPN egress and CI/CD runner subnet). The VPC has no NAT gateway or VPC peering to public networks. Additionally, the NLB has a listener policy with a fixed-response 403 for connections not matching the prefix list (defense-in-depth alongside SG). Route table for the private subnet has no 0.0.0.0/0 route. The only path to enqueue work is through the internal API which is reachable exclusively from the allowed CIDR ranges.

config.nlb_listener_default_action: fixed-response 403 unless source in prefix list
config.subnet_type: private, no IGW, no NAT, no public route
config.upload_api_access: internal only from corporate VPN and CI/CD runners
